2608.23308.title: FIDES: A Concordance Protocol for LLM-Generated Trading Strategies
2608.23308.paper_summary:
An LLM asked for a trading strategy returns three artifacts at once: a natural-language rationale, an executable implementation, and once run, a track record. Whether these are the same object is rarely checked. We present FIDES, a measurement protocol that treats them as three views to be reconciled rather than one deliverable to be graded. Through dual delivery, a single model call returns both a natural-language strategy with an explicit claimed edge and a self-contained strategy(df) function. FIDES executes the code in a sandbox against a lag-one out-of-sample backtest and scores three concordance gaps: say to do, do to real, and say to result.
  On 8 liquid US ETFs across four models plus a two-stage elicitation arm, 40 strategies, 2023 to 2024 out-of-sample, three findings stand out. First, concordance does not predict profit: only 2 of 40 strategies beat buy-and-hold, and a plain sma(50,200) rule outperforms every model's mean Sharpe. Second, self-assessment is badly calibrated: 32 of 40 strategies claim to beat buy-and-hold and exactly one does. Third, swapping the language-code judge for a second model flips say to do on more than half of items. Injecting Close.shift(-1) drops do to real by 0.33 on average, while our runtime future-information probe fired on neither clean nor injected code. We frame FIDES as a protocol for measurement fidelity, not a claim about market performance.
2608.23308.paper_summary_zh: 一個大型語言模型要求提供交易策略，並同時返回三個產物：一個自然語言的理由、一個可執行的實現，以及在運行後的記錄。這些是否為同一物件很少被檢查。我們提出了FIDES，一個測量協議，將它們視為三個需要調和的視角，而不是一個需要評分的交付物。通過雙重交付，單次模型調用返回一個帶有明確聲稱優勢的自然語言策略和一個自包含的策略(df)函數。FIDES在沙盒中執行代碼，針對一個滯後的樣本外回測，並評分三個一致性差距：說到做、做到真實，以及說到結果。<lb/>在八個流動性良好的美國ETF上，跨四個模型加上一個兩階段引導臂，40個策略，2023年至2024年的樣本外，三個發現特別突出。首先，一致性並不預測利潤：只有2個策略超越了買入並持有，而一個普通的sma(50,200)規則超越了每個模型的平均夏普比率。其次，自我評估的校準非常差：40個策略中有32個聲稱超越買入並持有，而實際上只有一個做到。第三，將語言-代碼判斷者替換為第二個模型，會使超過一半的項目在說到做之間翻轉。注入Close.shift(-1)平均使做到真實下降0.33，而我們的運行時未來信息探測器在乾淨代碼和注入代碼上均未觸發。我們將FIDES框架視為測量真實性的協議，而不是對市場表現的聲明。
